name: heldout-tptp10
description: Held-out corpus of axiom-fuzzer: 320 TPTP v10.0.0 problems in a development split (dev) and a TEST split (test). Names, hashes and TPTP header facts only; no problem text. See docs/preregistration.md.
preparation: Expand every include line in place with the complete included axiom file (benchmarks/corpus.py semantics); keep formula text, order, names and roles; no conjecture or status transformation. Prepared files are modifications of TPTP files: do not redistribute them without the TPTP maintainers' permission.

selection.eligibility: Problems with a conjecture role are not eligible (the parser accepts negated_conjecture only); every prepared file passed axiom-fuzzer's parser.

split_rule: Within each stratum, sort the cases by sha256("split-20261114:" + case) as a lowercase hex string; even positions (0, 2, ...) are dev, odd positions are test.
